title: Understanding Online Polarization Through Human-Agent Interaction in a Synthetic LLM-Based Social Network

bias_targets.methodology: Manipulating the ratio of pro- and contra-UBI (Universal Basic Income) content presented to users via a simulated recommendation system (e.g., 70% pro vs. 30% contra) and measuring its effect on human engagement levels and opinion formation.

Surveying human participants post-interaction to assess their perception of viewpoint balance, fair representation, and group polarization in a simulated social network populated by LLM agents with varying degrees of polarized stances.
